task: Isolate CodeMie identity (codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration) per global profile instead of the shared global workspace object, add migration 008 to backfill existing profiles, and fix statusline.ts's direct workspace.codeMieUrl bypass read.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: config schema (src/env/types.ts — codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration added directly to ProviderProfile), ConfigLoader service (src/utils/config.ts — resolveProfileWorkspace, resolveIdentitySource, saveProfile identity-merge semantics), migration subsystem (new 008-isolate-global-profile-identity migration + registration in src/migrations/index.ts), Claude agent plugin (statusline.ts's resolveBudget() reading the profile's own codeMieUrl instead of the shared workspace), project-config.md doc contract
component_scope.layers: config schema, service (ConfigLoader), migration, agent-tool, documentation

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Task description precisely named the root cause and the fix shape (move the identity trio onto each profile, add a migration, fix the statusline bypass). The one gap surfaced only during implementation: saveProfile()'s merge-vs-replace semantics for partial profile updates (a caller updating just `model` must not silently wipe already-stored identity) and migration 008's type-safety approach were refined in a follow-up code-review fix-up round (commit 966b64d7) rather than being fully specified up front.

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Modifies the core shared ConfigLoader identity-resolution path used by every profile load; requires a data migration (008) that rewrites every existing user's persisted global config file, cloning the shared workspace identity onto each pre-existing profile; a real correctness bug (saveProfile() dropping the identity trio on partial/unrelated profile updates) was found post-implementation and had to be fixed in a dedicated follow-up commit, confirming the risk was not merely theoretical.
technical_risk.mitigation: Reused the established Migration/MigrationRegistry pattern (7 prior migrations exist, including the closely related 006 workspace/provider-identity split this change builds directly on); migration 008 is unit-tested; the saveProfile() merge-semantics bug and the migration's `as any` type-safety gap were each caught and fixed with dedicated regression tests in the code-review fix-up round.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 4 distinct subsystems: the config schema (src/env/types.ts, moving the identity trio onto ProviderProfile), the core ConfigLoader service (src/utils/config.ts, including resolveProfileWorkspace/resolveIdentitySource and saveProfile's merge semantics), the migration subsystem (new 008 migration + registration), and the Claude plugin's statusline.ts, which previously bypassed ConfigLoader entirely by reading config.workspace?.codeMieUrl directly — plus a doc contract update.

Base M (established precedent from migration 006's closely related workspace/provider split) bumped to L by the data-migration red flag: migration 008 rewrites every existing user's persisted global config. The risk was not just theoretical — a real saveProfile() merge-semantics bug was discovered and fixed post-implementation.
9 files touched (7 modified, 2 new) spanning 5 directories — base L (8-10 file band) bumped to XL by the same data-migration red flag that applies to Technical Risk.

3 layers touched — DB-Persistence (persisted global config file + migration), Service (ConfigLoader's identity/workspace resolution), and Agent-Tool (statusline.ts's direct read fixed to go through the profile) — with a required migration, matching the L criteria (3-4 layers including persistence, migration required).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): requires a data migration (008-isolate-global-profile-identity.migration.ts) that rewrites every existing global profile's persisted identity trio.
File Change Estimate bumped from L (4) to XL (5): same data-migration red flag additionally bumps file change scope.
